:::{.info-card .info-card--course-content}
<div class="info-card__header">
  <span class="info-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">
    <img src="img/icons/book-stack.svg" alt="" class="info-card__icon-img">
  </span>
  <h2 class="info-card__heading">Training content</h2>
</div>

:::{.card-copy}
Train the Trainer offers guidance, ideas and tips for designing,
developing and delivering training, all based on research-driven
educational principles. The course is for anyone who is interested in
becoming a trainer or instructor, or in improving their training
skills.

The course is highly interactive: participants actively contribute to
all sessions. It is given by the SciLifeLab Training Hub, and based on
the materials of the
[ELIXIR-GOBLET Train-the-Trainer community](https://elixir-europe.org/platforms/training/train-the-trainer).
:::
:::

:::{.info-card .info-card--learning-outcomes}
<div class="info-card__header">
  <span class="info-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">
    <img src="img/icons/target.svg" alt="" class="info-card__icon-img">
  </span>
  <h2 class="info-card__heading">Learning outcomes</h2>
</div>

:::{.card-copy}
1. Name learning principles that a good teacher or instructor should have in mind
2. Describe at least three training techniques, drawing on learning principles
3. Design a training session and a course
4. Develop assessment questionnaires
5. Enumerate types of materials needed for each part of a training session or course
6. Describe strategies to promote engagement amongst learners
:::
:::
